title: Mathematics
description: ISC Class XII Mathematics theory units for the board examination, mapped to the CISCE syllabus (subject code 860).

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE ISC Mathematics (860) syllabus, examination year 2027: Paper I theory 3 hours 80 marks and Paper II Project Work 20 marks, total 100 marks. The 2027 revision removed the earlier choice between Section B and Section C and made all seven units compulsory: Relations and Functions (10), Algebra (10), Calculus (35), Vector Algebra (5), Three-Dimensional Geometry (6), Linear Programming (5) and Probability (9). The unit and topic list below was read from a publicly hosted copy of the CISCE syllabus document (dated February 2025, carrying the CISCE copyright notice); the cisce.org original returned HTTP 403 in this environment, so the wording remains UNVERIFIED against the primary source.
syllabusBaselines.note: All seven units of Paper I are registered. Chapter 1 (Relations and Functions) is a draft of original practice material; the remaining six units are registered with no chapter files yet. None of the chapters is published.
syllabusBaselines.syllabusSource: ISC Mathematics (860) syllabus for the examination year 2027, publicly hosted copy of the CISCE document; cisce.org regulations and syllabus page

groups.title: Relations and Functions

chapters.title: Relations and Functions

groups.title: Matrices and Determinants

chapters.title: Matrices and Determinants

groups.title: Calculus
